selectionMethod: feature, user journey, transaction boundary, and market comparison

why: rental candidates are searched and compared
property conditions and availability are recorded
the primary journey is discovery-to-inquiry rather than post-contract management
viewing, move-in, condition and verification checklists are present
there is no verified landlord, tenant, maintenance, rent-collection, or lease-management workflow
stay duration and nightly/weekly/monthly cost inputs exist
the product explicitly generates an inquiry only and has no verified reservation or payment flow

closestExternalComparators.comparison: Large Thailand property inventory, geographic and property-type discovery, and rental listing filters; CondoLink is comparatively a local decision-support tool.
Useful only as an adjacent trust-and-safety reference: reviews, listing accuracy, secure messaging, and on-platform payments are mature marketplace practices that CondoLink does not claim to provide.

nonComparableClaims: CondoLink is not evidenced as a full marketplace.
No evidence supports equivalence to a booking, payment, contract, or regulated property-management platform.
